ينسطل (form VII)
# يَنْسَطِلُ (yansaṭilu) /jan.sa.tˤi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# يَنْسَطِلَ (yansaṭila) /jan.sa.tˤi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
# يَنْسَطِلْ (yansaṭil) /jan.sa.tˤil/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَطَلَ (insaṭala)
